description:
Join Our Standard Affiliate Commission Program and Start Earning Today!

Bearded Dad is an online ecommerce store that specializes in laser engraving promotional and gift items. We specialize in Tumblers, Coasters, and Cutting Boards.  We have an online product customizer that is similar to any online t-shirt designer you have used. It is easy for the customer to use to design their perfect item. Customers really like getting the design just right for their husband or grandparent. It's also easy for business owners to put their logo on items, and we offer huge bulk discounts that pair well with promotional products at business level quanities. 

Are you looking for a hassle-free way to boost your income while promoting products you love? Look no further! Our Standard Affiliate Commission Program offers you the perfect opportunity to earn a generous commission on every sale, all while partnering with a brand you believe in.

Here's What You Can Expect:

1. A Generous 15% Commission: With our Percent of Sale commission rule, you earn a substantial 10% commission on every sale generated through your affiliate efforts. The more you promote, the more you earn!

2. No Lifetime Commission: We keep things transparent and straightforward. This program doesn't include lifetime commissions, ensuring that you're rewarded fairly for your marketing efforts.

3. No Automatic Customer Discounts: Your commissions won't be diluted by automatic customer discounts. Rest assured, you'll earn your full 10% on each sale.

4. Manual Affiliate Approval: We value quality over quantity. Our affiliate program involves manual approval to ensure we partner with affiliates who align with our brand values. Please take a moment to explore our website. We want to ensure that we're the right match for you. 

5. A 30-Day Cookie Duration: Our 30-day cookie duration ensures that you'll receive credit for sales made within a month of a customer clicking your affiliate link. Even if they don't buy immediately, you'll still earn your commission.

6. Multiple Payment Options: We believe in giving you flexibility when it comes to your earnings. You can choose from various payment methods, including PayPal, and Store Credit.

7. Powerful Promotion Tools: We provide you with an affiliate link that makes tracking your referrals a breeze. Share it across your networks, and watch your commissions grow.

8. Fair Policies: We value integrity. Self-referral commissions are not allowed in our program, ensuring a level playing field for all affiliates.

Get Started Today:

Joining our Standard Affiliate Commission Program is easy and free. Sign up now and gain access to our promotional materials, affiliate link, and comprehensive support. Whether you're a seasoned affiliate marketer or just starting, our program welcomes all levels of expertise.

Start earning commissions and become a valued member of our affiliate community today!

• Other information: I love being a dad, and I love laser engraving. Bearded Dad is the perfect pairing of those two things. We have a shop on our property where everyting is laser engraved here on site, and the kids get to learn and grow with the family business as it grows. 

We are looking for great people to help promote our brand. If you'd like to partner with us, please send me an email to Howdy@BeardedDad.com

Thank you, Steve

(Bearded Dad)
